sections.content: Evaluation expressions such as es *importante* *que*, es necesario que and me *parece* *bien* que take the subjunctive when evaluating an action or situation.

items.spanish: Es importante que escuchemos otras opiniones.
items.english: It is important that we listen to other opinions.
I think it is good that they participate.

items.spanish: Le preocupa que algunas decisiones afecten a quienes no participaron en el debate.
items.english: It worries her that some decisions might affect those who did not take part in the debate.
